admission.justification: The packaged serving copy is the surface the family's mirror guarantee now names, so this obligation is what states that guarantee.

applicability: Every canonical role, operation, criteria and onboarding text the tool server ships to a harness.
conditions: skills/ is the authoring source; mcp/src/agents_remember/package_data/runtime/skills is its generated serving copy, refreshed by scripts/sync-skills.py.
No shipped first-read text uses assignment_read.
No harness installs a copy of the skills: the generated-copy declaration names one target for source skills, and the retired sync and starter renderers are gone.
exclusions: Lifecycle rerouting or role resets by propagation.
statement: Canonical skills are authored in skills/ and propagated to the package-owned runtime skills tree for resource serving and capsule compilation, without installed harness mirrors.
